Asha: quick ping - ranked-lite-3b-ptq eval shows NDCG@10 regressed ~2.8% vs fp16 on our primary holdout. MRR@1 flat.
Devon: which holdout? and did you run with prod preprocessing?
Asha: holdout = holdout-v1-5k. fp16 NDCG@10 0.365, ptq NDCG@10 0.355. I suspect tokenizer or candidate truncation.
Ravi: last time candidate_pool_size mismatch caused drop. harness used pool 50, prod scoring uses 200.
Asha: harness config snippet: {"candidate_pool_size":50, "truncate_candidates":true, "preserve_order":false}
Devon: oof preserve_order false again. that tends to reshuffle near-ties. re-run both fp16 and ptq with candidate_pool_size=200 and preserve_order=true. pin seed to 2026.
Ravi: starting job now. cmd: ./ci/run_eval --run-id reeval-1739992222 --model ranked-lite-3b-ptq --seed 2026 --candidates 200 --preserve-order true --tokenizer /opt/tokenizers/splice-v2.4.model
TokenBot: queued reeval-1739992222. artifacts -> s3://evals/re_eval/1739992222/
RunnerBot: running on gpu-pool-staging-1. ETA ~9m.
Asha: once done pls dump per-slice NDCG deltas for short/long/multilang/ties and attach top 50 failing queries. we'll audit tokenization diffs if regression persists.
Devon: assigning: Ravi -> run, Asha -> triage failing queries, me -> tokenizer parity check.
Ravi: will post results here when finished.
